Name: CP - SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Angora Rabbit Replacers
Author: plurffle
Description:
Did you ever want your rabbits to be all fluffy in your coops? I did too, so here they are ready for your farm! ₍ ᐢ.ˬ.ᐢ₎ ♡

This mods comes with replacers of the adult rabbit sprites as well as the baby rabbits sprites, both rabbits coming with three colors (tan, tan with white, and white). The adult rabbits also comes with two different coat lengths: short-haired and long-haired. Everything is configurable!

Currently, the default rabbit is the long-haired white version, but you can definitely choose whichever you want in your game!


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]Unzip the zip file and place the "[CP] SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Rabbit Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is there going to be an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version of this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]You can get that here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42487]AT - SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Rabbit Replacers[/url]
